description:
Cast Glasspool Mimic by paying {2}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Glasspool Mimic, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, returning Glasspool Mimic from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Swift Warkite.
Repeat from step 2.
